candidates: The `queued` field default `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the class is defined, not when each instance is created. All `AssignmentSource` instances created via `from_integration()` will share the same timestamp from when the module was first imported. Should use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` instead.

The `assignment_source` parameter was added to the abstract `sync_status_outbound` method but is never used anywhere. The `sync_status_outbound` task calls `should_sync("outbound_status")` without any `sync_source` and calls `sync_status_outbound()` without passing `assignment_source`. This is dead code that adds confusion about whether status sync cycle prevention was intended to be implemented.
